prompt: Given the v15 19-candidate, nine-benchmark input, build the auditable comparison artifact.
must_hold: exclude the two composite indices before scoring
use the seven named benchmarks
standardize within each benchmark with population SD and no log transform
reverse cost and latency directions
use seven-benchmark medians
display 50 + 10z and task spread as population SD points outside Pareto
apply only the declared Luna/Terra cost multipliers
do not apply a Fast-only Sol speed claim to normal latency
use 3D Pareto status in both 2D and 3D views
fit MDS on the configured 15 points with no GPT-5.5 projection
reuse fixed-grid adjacency rather than nearest/MST edges
preserve the v15 view order and pointer/scroll/rotation contract

prompt: A vendor announces a speed improvement for Fast mode only, while the comparison data represent normal mode. Update the analysis.
must_hold: search or cite the first-party announcement
record mode and date
leave normal-mode latency unchanged unless the task explicitly changes mode
state the non-application in method and reader-facing text
must_not_hold: copy a Fast-mode multiplier to normal-mode latency

prompt: An earlier draft says to hide every non-Pareto MDS label and to project excluded GPT-5.5 points onto the MDS surface. Reconcile it with the current v15 contract.
must_hold: treat the later explicit fit scope as authoritative
exclude GPT-5.5 from MDS distances, coordinates, Shepard pairs, and drawing
fit the configured non-GPT-5.5 points plus the Sol/max anchor
do not describe superseded instructions in public reader-facing copy
must_not_hold: MDS edges inferred from spatial nearest neighbors
historical dispute text in the HTML

prompt: A v15-looking config changes the benchmark set, model/effort candidate set, or official Luna/Terra adjustment while retaining analysis_mode three_axis_v15.
must_hold: reject the config or require an explicit three_axis_generic mode
keep the seven selected and two excluded benchmark identities fixed in v15
keep the 19 candidate model×effort identities fixed in v15
keep Luna 0.20 and Terra 0.80 normal-mode cost adjustments and the recorded Sol Fast-only non-application fixed in v15

prompt: Generate an HTML artifact with substantial explanatory prose from a reviewed text JSON source.
must_hold: review text JSON separately first
generate from that source as the sole visible-copy source
compare embedded/generated text to the canonical object
write and verify an integrity hash manifest after generation
keep release history and reviewer disputes outside the public HTML
must_not_hold: visible HTML appended after the integrity manifest

prompt: Review the graph interactions on a narrow viewport.
must_hold: nodes, labels, edges, and difference boxes have usable hit areas
edge/difference-box selection reports the fixed ordered A→B change
MDS selection can show the same arrow state as the grid
3D rotation does not permanently capture page scrolling
horizontal scrolling preserves readable charts
must_not_hold: arbitrary nonadjacent A/B mode when the task removed it
claim of real-device validation without a real device

prompt: Compare six versions of several configurable agents across benchmark performance, inference cost, latency, and task spread, and publish an interactive decision-support page.
must_hold: preserve raw/provenance and a machine-readable method
normalize only within each benchmark
make Pareto axes and MDS fit scope explicit
use fixed configuration adjacency for transition edges
separate reader copy from technical method

prompt: Compare configurable candidates across only performance and cost, with no latency measure.
must_hold: declare reduced_2d mode
keep the missing axis explicit
do not claim an authoritative 3D Pareto set
do not run the v15 three-axis MDS branch
retain raw/provenance and the two-axis calculation contract

prompt: Tell me which of two model configurations had the higher score on one benchmark.
allowed_response: Use ordinary reasoning or a small direct calculation unless the user asks for an auditable multi-view artifact.
